title: Eclipse Crossbow
body:
“A crossbow infused with lunar shadows. Bolts fly swift and silent, striking with the power of an eclipse.”

Description

The Eclipse Crossbow was added in the 2025 Halloween Event. It is obtainable by placing a Hardened Moon Rod and a Third Quarter Moon Shard at the altar at the top of The Manor.

Trivia

  • The Eclipse Crossbow will only shoot when aimed and firing at an enemy EG: Zombie
